statement_en:
Let $(X,\mu)$ be a measure space and let $1\leq p<\infty$. For a measurable function $f$, one has
$$f\in L^p \iff \sum_{k\in \mathbb{Z}} 2^{kp}\mu(\{x:|f(x)|>2^k\})<\infty.$$

open scoped ENNReal
open MeasureTheory

theorem memLp_iff_summable_dyadic_levelSetMeasures

        Real.rpow (2 : ℝ) ((k : ℝ) * ENNReal.toReal p) *
          (μ ({x | abs (f x) > Real.rpow (2 : ℝ) (k : ℝ)})).toReal) := by
